type.quote: There is hereby created within the department of commerce, the Ohio construction industry licensing board, consisting of seventeen residents of this state. The board shall have an administrative section and three specialty sections: a plumbing and hydronics section, an electrical section, and a heating, ventilating, air conditioning, and refrigeration section.

exams.name: Contractor examination for heating, ventilating, and air conditioning
exams.notes: Must attain a passing score within 12 months preceding application for licensure. Applicant may retake exam no sooner than 60 days after most recent exam. After failing 5 times, applicant must reapply before retaking.
exams.jurisdiction: state (Ohio Construction Industry Licensing Board administers via contracted testing entity)
exams.quote: an applicant does not pass the required examination after taking the examination five times under this section shall reapply for a license under division (A) of this section before retaking the required examination any subsequent time.

interval_years.quote: All licenses a contractor holds pursuant to this chapter shall expire annually on the same date

required.quote: A requirement that an individual who holds any number of valid and unexpired licenses accrue a total of ten hours of continuing education courses per year

value: specialty-section-established curriculum (up to 5 hours per year in specific course requirements)
topical_requirements.quote: No curriculum may require more than five hours per year in specific course requirements. No contractor may be required to take more than ten hours per year in continuing education courses.

available.quote: When a written reciprocity agreement between the states exists, and an individual who is registered, licensed, or certified in another state applies to the appropriate specialty section of the Ohio construction industry licensing board submits a copy of the reciprocity agreement, and pays the licensure fee determined pursuant to section 4740.09 of the Revised Code, the appropriate specialty section of the board shall authorize the administrative section to issue, without examination, a license to that individual

requirements.value: Written reciprocity agreement between Ohio and the other state must exist; other state's requirements must be substantially equal to Ohio's; other state must extend similar reciprocity to Ohio licensees; applicant pays licensure fee.
requirements.quote: the appropriate specialty section of the board determines, pursuant to rules it adopts, that the requirements for registration, licensure, or certification under the laws of the other state are substantially equal to the requirements for licensure in this state and that the other state extends similar reciprocity to persons licensed under this chapter.
